description.value: Pallet Coffee Roasters is a locally-owned Vancouver specialty coffee roastery and cafe chain, established in East Vancouver in 2014, now operating eight locations across Metro Vancouver. The Kingsway location is one of several cafes serving espresso and filter coffee made from ethically sourced, in-house roasted beans alongside food and freshly baked goods. Beyond its cafes, Pallet functions as a full-service roastery, barista training provider, and wholesale partner to businesses across Canada.
